Use case: stylized-concept. Production game sprite sheet for a realistic unarmed H135-style light civilian SECURITY PATROL HELICOPTER. Genuine transparent background. Exactly 16 individual equally scaled helicopter sprites on a precise 4-column by 4-row grid, cells equally spaced, generous transparent padding, no grid lines and no text. Each cell contains complete aircraft including rotor and tail. Same aircraft, navy blue and white civilian livery, realistic streamlined twin-engine cabin, wraparound cockpit windows, correct skids, slender tail boom and enclosed tail fan; small observation camera below nose; no weapons, no cartoon smiling face, no futuristic engines or jet flames, no logos. Orthographic elevated TOP-DOWN video-game view approximately 65 degrees downward, consistent world camera and lighting; sharply rendered game pixels and believable proportions (12m length,10m rotor diameter), clearly legible at 80px scale. Main rotor represented by two slightly different thin blade motion-blur phases, a transparent subtle rotor arc with visible hub, not a giant solid disk.
First two rows represent eight flight headings: row1 columns1..4 nose NORTH, NORTHEAST, EAST, SOUTHEAST. Row2 columns1..4 nose SOUTH, SOUTHWEST, WEST, NORTHWEST. Last two rows repeat exactly these same eight poses with identical body positioning and different main-rotor blade angle (phase2); row3 N,NE,E,SE; row4 S,SW,W,NW. Each entire helicopter centered in its grid cell; no clipping no neighboring cell overlap. Body rotates appropriately with heading while camera remains fixed above; correct front/back tail relationship. Clean professional pixel-game art, realistic aircraft silhouette, no scene background or ground shadow.
